name: Login modal — opens and accepts phone number input

planSteps.description: Click the 'Sign in' button in the header
A login modal or dialog appears on screen
The modal contains a phone number input field and a role selection (Owner / Tenant)
Type '9876543210' into the phone number input field
The phone input field shows the value '9876543210'
Click the Send OTP or Get OTP button
An OTP input field appears, or a message is displayed asking to enter the OTP
